# swayidle

Idle handling: dim, lock, panel off.

See [Session](../session.md#idle). Dimming is dimland (AUR).

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`swayidle/packages`): `swayidle`, `dimland-git` (AUR: dims the screen before the lock)

**Linked into your home** (stow, `install.sh --link`):

- `~/.config/systemd/user/swayidle.service`

**User units** (enabled by `install.sh --units`): `swayidle.service`
